requirement: Generate an 8-bit FPGA RTL project that joins two input streams, accumulates joined samples, and exposes one output stream.

intent.user_prompt: Generate an 8-bit FPGA RTL project that joins two input streams, accumulates joined samples, and exposes one output stream.
intent.design_goal: Dual-stream join with accumulation, streaming interface
assumptions: Clocked at 100 MHz
Active-low reset
Valid-ready handshake for all streams
Inputs and output are 8-bit
Accumulator saturates? No, wraps modulo 256

control_flow.name: in0_buffer_load
control_flow.effects: skid_buf0_data = top.in0_data; skid_buf0_valid = 1

control_flow.name: in1_buffer_load
control_flow.effects: skid_buf1_data = top.in1_data; skid_buf1_valid = 1

control_flow.name: join_handshake
control_flow.effects: join.data_out = skid_buf0_data + skid_buf1_data; join.valid_out = 1; skid_buf0_valid = 0; skid_buf1_valid = 0

control_flow.name: accumulator_load
control_flow.effects: accum_reg = accum_reg + join.data_out; accum_valid = 1; join.valid_out = 0

control_flow.name: out_stage_load
control_flow.effects: out_stage_data = accum_reg; out_stage_valid = 1; accum_valid = 0

control_flow.name: top_output_handshake
control_flow.effects: top.out_valid = 1; out_stage_valid = 0

control_flow.name: join_fsm_idle_to_wait
control_flow.effects: join_fsm = WAIT_BOTH

control_flow.name: join_fsm_wait_to_output
control_flow.effects: join_fsm = OUTPUT

control_flow.name: join_fsm_output_to_idle
control_flow.effects: join_fsm = IDLE

scenarios.name: basic_join_accumulate
scenarios.stimulus: Drive both inputs with data values 0x01-0x05 sequentially with valid, allow full throughput
scenarios.pass_condition: Out_data equals cumulative sum modulo 256 after each transaction

scenarios.name: backpressure_test
scenarios.pass_condition: No data loss, accumulation correct after all transfers

verification.pass_condition: testbench prints TEST_PASS and no TEST_FAIL

requirement: Generate an 8-bit FPGA RTL project that joins two input streams, accumulates joined samples, and exposes one output stream.

intent.user_prompt: Generate an 8-bit FPGA RTL project that joins two input streams, accumulates joined samples, and exposes one output stream.
intent.design_goal: Dual-stream join with accumulation, using standard handshake interfaces.
assumptions: Input streams are valid-ready with 8-bit data.
Output stream is valid-ready with accumulated 16-bit data.
Clock frequency 100 MHz, active-low reset.
Buffering depth of 2 for each input stream.

control_flow.name: reset_all
control_flow.effects: All state machines reset to IDLE, accumulator_reg cleared, skid buffers emptied.

control_flow.name: skid_buffer_handshake_in0
control_flow.effects: Data sampled into skid buffer in0.

control_flow.name: skid_buffer_handshake_in1
control_flow.effects: Data sampled into skid buffer in1.

control_flow.name: join_handshake
control_flow.condition: join_fsm state == PASS and both inputs valid
control_flow.effects: Join produces output data on out_valid/out_data.

control_flow.name: output_handshake
control_flow.effects: Output accumulated sample via m_axis_tdata
